class TraceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    REQ = request(
        {"op": "FILTER", "where": "x > 0"},
        {"op": "branch", "branches": [
            {"when": "x > 5", "steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "big", "expr": "true"}]},
            {"when": "x > 100", "steps": [{"op": "limit", "n": 1}]},
            {"when": "otherwise", "steps": []},
        ]},
        {"op": "limit", "n": 2},
        dataset=[{"x": 1}, {"x": 7}, {"x": -1}, {"x": 3}],
    )

    def test_spec_example(self):
        out, code = run_cli(self.REQ, "--execute", "--trace")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        self.assertEqual(out["data"], [{"x": 7, "big": True}, {"x": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(out["metrics"], {"rows_in": 4, "rows_out": 2})
        self.assertEqual(out["trace"], [
            {"path": "pipeline.steps[0]", "op": "filter", "rows_in": 4, "rows_out": 3},
            {"path": "pipeline.steps[1]", "op": "branch", "rows_in": 3, "rows_out": 3},
            {"path": "pipeline.steps[1].branches[0].steps[0]", "op": "map", "rows_in": 1, "rows_out": 1},
            {"path": "pipeline.steps[1].branches[1].steps[0]", "op": "limit", "rows_in": 0, "rows_out": 0},
            {"path": "pipeline.steps[2]", "op": "limit", "rows_in": 3, "rows_out": 2},
        ])

    def test_nested_branch_order(self):
        req = request(
            {"op": "branch", "branches": [
                {"when": "otherwise", "steps": [
                    {"op": "branch", "branches": [{"when": "x > 1", "steps": [{"op": "limit", "n": 5}]}]},
                    {"op": "limit", "n": 1},
                ]},
            ]},
            dataset=[{"x": 1}, {"x": 2}, {"x": 3}],
        )
        out, _ = run_cli(req, "--execute", "--trace")
        self.assertEqual(
            [(e["path"], e["rows_in"], e["rows_out"]) for e in out["trace"]],
            [
                ("pipeline.steps[0]", 3, 1),
                ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].steps[0]", 3, 2),
                ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].steps[0].branches[0].steps[0]", 2, 2),
                ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].steps[1]", 2, 1),
            ],
        )

    def test_trace_ignored_without_execute_or_on_error(self):
        self.assertEqual(run_cli(self.REQ, "--trace"), run_cli(self.REQ))
        self.assertEqual(run_cli(self.REQ, "--trace", "--execute=false"), run_cli(self.REQ))
        bad = request({"op": "select", "columns": ["y"]}, dataset=[{"x": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(run_cli(bad, "--execute", "--trace"), run_cli(bad, "--execute"))
